name: ai-todo
description: AI 智能待办事项桌面应用：登录注册、自然语言建任务、AI 自动判优先级与分类、定时提醒
author: ai_todo

scripts.start: bun run build:renderer && bun run build:main && node scripts/launch.js
scripts.build:renderer: bun build src/renderer/src/app.ts --outfile src/renderer-dist/app.js --target browser --format iife --minify && bun build src/renderer/src/float.ts --outfile src/renderer-dist/float.js --target browser --format iife --minify && bun build src/renderer/src/notify.ts --outfile src/renderer-dist/notify.js --target browser --format iife --minify && bunx --bun @tailwindcss/cli -i src/renderer/styles.css -o src/renderer-dist/styles.css --minify
scripts.build:main: bun build src/main/main.ts --outfile dist-electron/main.js --target node --external electron --format cjs && bun build src/preload.ts --outfile dist-electron/preload.js --target node --external electron --format cjs
scripts.prebuild: bun run build:renderer && bun run stamp && bun run build:main
scripts.build: bun run prebuild && bun run prepack:dir && electron-builder --dir --win --x64 && node scripts/pack-exe.js && electron-builder --win --x64 --prepackaged dist/win-unpacked
